items.source: Find the HandlerMapping that would handle the given request and return a MatchableHandlerMapping to use for path matching.
items.translation: 查找将处理给定请求的HandlerMapping，并返回一个用于路径匹配的MatchableHandlerMapping。

items.source: Uses of MatchableHandlerMapping in org.springframework.web.servlet.function.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.function.support` 包中 `MatchableHandlerMapping` 的用法

items.source: Uses of MatchableHandlerMapping in org.springframework.web.servlet.handler
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.handler` 包中 `MatchableHandlerMapping` 的用法

items.source: Uses of MatchableHandlerMapping in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation` 包中 `MatchableHandlerMapping` 的用法

items.source: Uses of MatchableHandlerMapping in org.springframework.web.socket.server.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.socket.server.support` 包中 `MatchableHandlerMapping` 的用法

items.source: Creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations in @Controller classes.
items.translation: 从 `<@Controller>` 类中的类型级和方法级@RequestMapping及@HttpExchange注解创建RequestMappingInfo实例。

items.source: Extension of SimpleUrlHandlerMapping with support for more precise mapping of WebSocket handshake requests to handlers of type WebSocketHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: 支持将 WebSocket 握手请求更精确地映射到类型为 WebSocketHttpRequestHandler 的处理器，从而扩展了 SimpleUrlHandlerMapping。

items.source: HandlerMapping implementation that supports RouterFunctions.
items.translation: 支持RouterFunctions的HandlerMapping实现。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the HandlerMapping interface, detecting URL mappings for handler beans through introspection of all defined beans in the application context.
items.translation: `HandlerMapping` 接口的抽象实现，通过检查应用上下文中定义的所有 bean 来检测处理器的 URL 映射。

items.source: Abstract base class for URL-mapped HandlerMapping implementations.
items.translation: 用于 URL 映射的 `HandlerMapping` 实现的抽象基类。

items.source: Implementation of the HandlerMapping interface that maps from URLs to beans with names that start with a slash ("/"), similar to how Struts maps URLs to action names.
items.translation: 实现 `HandlerMapping` 接口，该接口将 URL 映射到以斜杠（"/"）开头的名称的 Bean，类似于 Struts 将 URL 映射到动作名称的方式。

items.source: Implementation of the HandlerMapping interface that maps from URLs to request handler beans.
items.translation: 实现用于将 URL 映射到请求处理器 Bean 的HandlerMapping接口。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source:
Provides standard HandlerMapping implementations,
including abstract base classes for custom implementations.
items.translation: 提供标准的 HandlerMapping 实现，包括用于自定义实现的抽象基类。

items.source:
Server-side support classes including container-specific strategies
for upgrading a request.
items.translation: 服务器端支持类，包括用于升级请求的特定容器策略。
